blocks.text: ​Picture this: you’re having a pretty chill day, minding your own business, when suddenly an unexpected curveball of disaster hits you in the face. Most likely, you’ll react two ways. Old- school logic says it’s probably time for a meltdown. If you’re Gen Z though, you’ll most likely drop a deadpan joke, send a chaotic meme about it in the group chat, and move on. ​When it comes to their brand of humor, young adults often get flak for being flat, random, or detached.
